game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the knight must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 1: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for C origins.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: door_health drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.

No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while door_health > 0.
